readings: Considering only advanced behaviour analyses whose linked transaction record and trader both exist, for each trader type (`tradekind`) give the trader type, the number of analysis records (a transaction analysed twice counts twice), and that number divided by the total of these numbers over all trader types, without rounding.
queries:
SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS proportion
FROM advancedbehavior a
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON a.translink = tr.transreg
JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
GROUP BY t.tradekind
